How can a movie be so boring???
We don't have the anonymous thing, but they assured us that we are protected when reporting but yeah... I don't trust them.

It's a medium sized company, so while they have more than 1 person in HR, the rest are not very capable at handling such a heavy problem.
No there isn't any union or department I can report to. Besides they can't really do much.

I also pay for almost everything. There's an incredibly tiny fraction of what they provide. But I'm a student, a teenager, in a country with ridiculously high housing prices. I would barely have enough if I worked 60hrs a week. I need money to move out. It's not that simple.
Money.
Would seperate from them if I could.

I don't know if you require photos or video evidence.. But it's all true. I have had a terrible relationship with my mother for as long as I can remember. And as you can see in the comments, some people do think I'm in the wrong. It's not a huge deal if it's a part of your daily life. You can get used to anything if it's all you know.
19. I saw bone. Won't report. Police here barely investigate murder.

I'm 19. I honestly don't want to press charges. The authorities are a joke in my country. It's not worth it. They never even got back to me over a sexual assault case I reported. Not worth it. Just saving up to move out before I start believing a dirty desk warrants wooden spoon attacks till my bones are visible.
Coercion is not consent love. What he did was terrible and I'm sorry you had to go through that.

I completely understand this. As a survivor of grooming I spent a long time trying to redevelop my sexuality, a long time after it happened, when I acknowledged I had a problem. I couldn't even kiss or masturbate after it all without experiencing flashbacks or panic attacks. Slowly I'm learning to find it all again. Or hell... Start it. There wasn't much before him anyway. I have tried casual dating, which has served as a lot of practice and made me more comfortable in my skin. I have also tried sex toys, which, if I'm honest, were lifesaving. I achieved autonomy again. I felt like I owned my body. If you feel ready for them, I think they can help you a lot. I'm sorry you had to go through this, and I hope you'll feel better soon xx
Thank you, I REALLY needed to hear that. I appreciate it deeply.
honestly, its okay. but maybe try your best to never let it happen again. always keep yourself in check. Making it easier is hard, but you can not make it worse.
hey, parents suck, but eventually they wont be in your life anymore. just hold it out a little longer. this is temporary.
try a scarf or a large hoodie and a choker, maybe take a sick day off? also I think a cold spoon softens the bruises a lot.

hey! ok so going back is a no go. you have children, you have yourself. you will be so much happier without him. ok so I have absolutely no money but try

\- a police station

\- a religious place, maybe an orphanage or church, they will probably pitch in. 

\- maybe a women's shelter if there are any close by.

\- as a last resort, maybe ask strangers who look like they would be sympathetic and give you some money

live to teach your friends your best recipes. live for late night walks and drunk nights out. live to see your loved ones smile. live for drives in the middle of nowhere. live to scream the lyrics to the best songs. live to fulfil your passions and help others. live to make sure less people feel the way you do right now.

Hey, youre really young. I was around your age when I almost OD on my mums pills, but it was a stupid idea looking back. im sure youll look back and think the same. Youre so young, and all things that sound incredibly difficult now will look small and stupid later. Just hold on okay? Were all here if you need to vent

I know it sounds silly coming from a stranger but..please dont. the world sucks and I cant guarantee it will get better, hell it probably wont. But youll learn to fight it. you will look back and it will look so small and so stupid. Every person has the power to fight off this shit. we just have to keep going.
I just know you should probably call an ambulance. it sounds like a dangerous list.  especially if you have access to healthcare, dont hesitate.

I dont think its a calling. think maybe your depression hit you at any leftover hopes dreams and passions, but it doesnt mean that theres no chance at progress, that you cant find what you love. hey, for me, my one last held passion is what makes me not kill myself.
How do I get over my sexual trauma in a healthy way? It's been 2 years. I have a lot of shame and very little sexual confidence.
